listing.name: Sin and Punishment — snprecomp (wootbeer)
listing.summary: Native Sin and Punishment with an original-ROM picker and separate saves for supported Japanese and English versions.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Japanese ROM with SHA-1 581297b9d5c3a4c33169ae0aae218c742cd9cbcf, or an English variant with SHA-1 5945ff3935d9d9531bbb5cfcabed7c198e2b2f41 or e3906c919236dac6eba020b4b8c1df91fd725c5d. This guide has not confirmed other translations; check the project’s requirements before using one.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract the complete package to a writable folder. On Windows run SnPRecompiled.exe. On Linux run SnPRecompiled.sh from the extracted folder. Choose Load ROM and select your own supported copy, then start the game.

steps.title: Use the prepared Linux copy
steps.instruction: After completing upstream setup, select the SnPRecompiled binary as the executable and its containing folder as the working directory. Choose Play when you want to start that external copy. The .exe in the next step is for Windows.

warnings: Upstream marks the Linux and Steam Deck routes untested. Portcove has not observed native setup or gameplay.

The Android app disables Android backup. Clearing its data or uninstalling can remove its imported ROM and separate Japanese and English saves. Keep your external original and update io.github.wootbeer.snprecomp with the same package identity and signer.

references.title: Keep the right saves
references.instruction: Keep the installed snprecomp profile and your original files before replacing the package. On Linux, the default profile is ~/.config/snprecomp. The portable.txt mode stores data with the application. Japanese and English profiles have separate saves.

references.title: Set up the separate Android ARM64 app
references.instruction: Use SnPRecompiled-0.2.11-android.apk from the upstream release on Android 9 or newer. It needs a Vulkan driver with descriptor indexing. Open the app and choose Load ROM to select your original with the system picker. The app copies it into its own storage.

data_locations: the existing snprecomp profile or the application folder when portable.txt is present
